title: Witnesses of Faith
description: The author of the Letter to the Hebrews defines faith and gives a powerful listing of heroes of faith throughout salvation history—from Abel, Enoch, and Noah, through Abraham, Sarah, Isaac, Jacob, Joseph, and Moses, to Rahab, the judges, David, and the prophets—as examples to follow.
